summary: TScan Therapeutics filed an 8-K reporting that Amgen terminated the Research Collaboration and License Agreement (May 8, 2023) for Crohn's disease targets, effective November 10, 2026 after 90-day notice. No termination penalty applies; TScan received a $30M upfront in 2023 and is winding down activities. Future milestones/royalties (over $500M potential) cease unless Amgen continues exploiting candidates. Watch for any survival of milestone obligations if Amgen proceeds, but likely no recurring revenue.
